study type: Qualitative secondary analysis of a prospective study
outcome: Patients' experiences of having an unplanned cesarean birth
cohort: 22 low-income postpartum individuals who labored prior to their cesarean birth at a single, tertiary-care center
finding: Individuals who experienced an unplanned cesarean birth after labor expressed negative feelings of self-blame, failure, and mistrust, but also positive feelings of self-efficacy.
